## Summary

Describe the observable change and why it belongs at the one-shot subagent boundary.

## Contract impact

- [ ] Matching remains fail-closed and completion-order independent for distinct sibling requests.
- [ ] Format/version and exact DSH compatibility impact are documented.
- [ ] Persistence, redaction, and replay-safety implications are documented.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] Regression or contract tests added/updated
- [ ] Concurrency, cancellation, and failure tests added where relevant
- [ ] English and Chinese user documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible behavior

Include focused test output or explain why a check does not apply. Never attach real cassette data or credentials.
